text: {"lessons":["Repeatedly trimming Stock A just because it was profitable may have reduced my exposure without a clear portfolio-based reason; I should set allocation targets and rebalance deliberately.","Selling Stock D and Stock E at steep losses reminds me to define downside and review the investment thesis before losses grow, rather than letting loss aversion delay a decision.","After buying Stock B and later selling part at a loss, I should make entry and exit plans in advance and avoid reacting to short-term account swings."]}
